work.summary: Replaced FINAL.22's fixed single-vending-machine task mode with a true selection-type target. Operators can search and select any number of individual vending machines in one task, remove selections before save, and continue using the existing all/manufacturer-wide targeting. Existing single-machine/custom target types migrate to selection semantics without losing their machine IDs. Percentage auto-completion remains unchanged.
implemented: Changed task target mode label/value from fixed '自販機1台' to '選択型'.
Changed task creation state from one selected machine ID to an arbitrary selectedMachineIds array.
Added a selected-machine count/list with remove controls before task save.
Search results can add multiple arbitrary machines without clearing prior selections.
Selection tasks persist targetType='selected' with all selected targetMachineIds.
Existing targetType machine/custom/selected values migrate to selected while preserving targetMachineIds.
Task Detail target changes convert customized target sets to selection-type while threshold-only edits leave manufacturer targeting intact.
Retained manufacturer/all task creation and FINAL.22 percentage auto-completion behavior.
Updated tests/task-target-threshold-ui-gate.html for multi-machine selection, manufacturer targeting, legacy threshold editing, 70% completion, and selected-target detail editing.
The first PR gate run 37321574425 exposed a test-harness render timing issue only; the gate was corrected to wait for initial task rendering.
PR #142 browser regression run 37321748627 then passed all five gates.
Main browser regression run 37321896627 passed all five gates.
Vercel production status for the main merge passed.

openItems: Real-device confirmation that selection-type creation is convenient for choosing multiple arbitrary vending machines.
Real-device confirmation that percentage completion still behaves as expected with selection-type tasks.
nextAction: Return to normal field use with FINAL.23. Choose 選択型 for any arbitrary set of one or more vending machines; use manufacturer mode when the whole manufacturer scope is intended.
unresolved: Historical Analytics remains preserved; user-facing Analysis/OCR remains withdrawn; numeric learning promotion remains disabled.
